text:
jessica: Escalation from Acme — after the canary to mistral-7b-v1 this morning, their JSON-mode outputs are changing shape. They see top-level keys renamed and arrays serialized as strings. Customer is blocked in prod.

jessica: Customer repro (sent to support):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "mode": "json",
  "model": "mistral-7b-v1",
  "input": "summarize: ...",
  "schema": {\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {\"items\": {\"type\": \"array\", \"items\": {\"type\": \"object\"}}}}
```

jessica: Expected (what their service validates against):
```json
{"items": [{"id": "123", "text": "..."}]}
```

jessica: Actual (what we returned):
```json
{"item_list": "[{\"id\":\"123\",\"text\":\"...\"}]"}
```

samir: Oof. Do we have the request_id / trace? I want logs and the exact model binary.

jessica: request_id=rid-0a9f7c, customer-ts=2026-03-16T09:12:34Z. Attached their raw response (above). They said this started at ~09:05 after auto-canary rolled.

deploy-bot: Canaried deploy completed: service=runtime-mistral, version=mistral-7b-v1, rollout=canary, start=2026-03-16T09:00:12Z, finished=2026-03-16T09:07:03Z

tim: Did the canary include any structured_output post-processing change? e.g., wrapper keys, or a transform hook?

nina: I checked the diff — runtime had a small tidy: normalize_structured_output renamed some internal keys to be more consistent (commit 7b9c). It looked safe, but maybe the mapping differs for our MML-format->JSON serializer.

samir: Can we repro locally by pinning the canary binary and replaying their request? If arrays are being stringified, it smells like a serializer escaping path taken when a metadata wrapper is added.

oncall-engineer: Recommendation: roll back canary on the tenant route for Acme. Set routing override to model=mistral-7b-v1-legacy (if available) or force the previous model version. I'll apply a temporary route rule.

jessica: Customer asks ETA. They can't process orders. Please confirm rollback and if we have a hotfix.

samir: I'll try a quick repro now. Steps:
1) pin model to mystic binary from yesterday
2) call with their exact schema and input, JSON mode on
3) compare serializer output vs canary

samir: If repro matches, fix could be a one-line serializer guard: when wrapper present, do not call stringify on arrays. But need tests.

nina: Also add an eval to prevent regressions: run their prompt+schema across model variants and assert structural equality of parsed JSON fields.

jessica: I've applied route override to send Acme to mistral-7b-v0.9 (pre-canary). Customer confirmed they can process one request successfully.

oncall-engineer: Logged incident with priority P1, tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml. Incident ID: INC-2026-0316-42.

samir: Repro done locally: canary binary returns the mutated shape. I pushed a draft hotfix branch (fix/serializer-guard). Minimal change, adding a check that avoids stringifying arrays when schema indicates array type.

tim: Ping eng-ml to review serialization assumptions. Might be model tokenizer/gen change causing unexpected tokens that downstream postproc interprets as wrapper metadata.

nina: Opening a bug: BUG-5242 — "structured-output: arrays serialized as strings after mistral-7b-v1 canary". Include: request_id, commit (7b9c), repro steps, sample input/output, customer impact, and rollback timeline.

jessica: Customer notified, happy with temporary routing. They've asked to be kept updated. I'll attach the incident link to the support ticket.

samir: I'll open a PR for the hotfix and request an expedited review. If we can get a canary patch out in the next 2-3 hours, we can re-route customers back quickly.

nina: Noted. Adding regression eval to the Optimize suite as well so this is caught in future canaries.

jessica: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the customer after PR merges and we redeploy. :thumbsup:
